GO", "sp_upsert": "CREATE OR ALTER PROC [dbo].[sp_factoryArtifacts]
    @pjsonfile VARCHAR(MAX)
AS
SET NOCOUNT ON
DECLARE @Outputmessage NVARCHAR(MAX) = '{
  "result": [
    {{ "value": "", "msg": "", "error": "" }}
  ]
}'
BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    DECLARE @action INT = (
        SELECT TOP 1 TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.action'))
        FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.factoryArtifacts')
    );

    DECLARE @payload TABLE (
        factoryArtifactId   INT NULL,
        factoryRunRef       NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
        layer               NVARCHAR(20) NULL,
        iterationNumber     INT NULL,
        content             NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        contentHash         NVARCHAR(64) NULL,
        layerScore          INT NULL,
        layerPassed         BIT NULL,
        issuesSummary       NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
        generatedByModel    NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
        active              BIT NULL
    );

    INSERT INTO @payload (
        factoryArtifactId,
        factoryRunRef,
        layer,
        iterationNumber,
        content,
        contentHash,
        layerScore,
        layerPassed,
        issuesSummary,
        generatedByModel,
        active
    )
    SELECT
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.factoryArtifactId')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.factoryRunRef'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.layer'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.iterationNumber')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.content'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.contentHash'),
        TRY_CONVERT(INT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.layerScore')),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.layerPassed')),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.issuesSummary'),
        JSON_VALUE(value, '$.generatedByModel'),
        TRY_CONVERT(BIT, JSON_VALUE(value, '$.active'))
    FROM OPENJSON(@pjsonfile, '$.factoryArtifacts');

    IF @action = 1 -- INSERT
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload
            GROUP BY factoryRunRef, layer, iterationNumber
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate factory artifact entries within the payload for the same factoryRunRef, layer, and iterationNumber.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.FactoryArtifacts fa
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.factoryRunRef = p.factoryRunRef
                                 AND fa.layer = p.layer
                                 AND fa.iterationNumber = p.iterationNumber
            WHERE fa.active = 1 -- Assuming uniqueness only for active records if soft-delete is implied by 'active' field.
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Factory Artifact already exists for this factoryRunRef, layer, and iterationNumber.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        INSERT INTO dbo.FactoryArtifacts (
            factoryRunRef,
            layer,
            iterationNumber,
            content,
            contentHash,
            layerScore,
            layerPassed,
            issuesSummary,
            generatedByModel,
            active,
            created_At
        )
        SELECT
            p.factoryRunRef,
            p.layer,
            p.iterationNumber,
            p.content,
            p.contentHash,
            p.layerScore,
            p.layerPassed,
            p.issuesSummary,
            p.generatedByModel,
            ISNULL(p.active, 1), -- Default active to 1 if not provided for INSERT
            GETDATE()
        FROM @payload p;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 2 -- UPDATE
    BEGIN
        -- Check for duplicates within the payload, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM @payload p
            GROUP BY p.factoryRunRef, p.layer, p.iterationNumber
            HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Duplicate factory artifact entries within the payload for the same factoryRunRef, layer, and iterationNumber.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        -- Check for conflicts against existing table, excluding the record being updated itself
        IF EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM dbo.FactoryArtifacts fa
            INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.factoryRunRef = p.factoryRunRef
                                 AND fa.layer = p.layer
                                 AND fa.iterationNumber = p.iterationNumber
            WHERE fa.factoryArtifactId <> p.factoryArtifactId
              AND fa.active = 1 -- Assuming uniqueness only for active records
        )
        BEGIN
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
            SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Factory Artifact already exists for this factoryRunRef, layer, and iterationNumber.');
            COMMIT TRANSACTION;
            GOTO Finish;
        END

        UPDATE fa
        SET
            factoryRunRef    = p.factoryRunRef,
            layer            = p.layer,
            iterationNumber  = p.iterationNumber,
            content          = p.content,
            contentHash      = p.contentHash,
            layerScore       = p.layerScore,
            layerPassed      = p.layerPassed,
            issuesSummary    = p.issuesSummary,
            generatedByModel = p.generatedByModel,
            active           = p.active,
            updated_at       = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.FactoryArtifacts fa
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.factoryArtifactId = p.factoryArtifactId;
    END
    ELSE IF @action = 3 -- DELETE (soft delete using 'active' field)
    BEGIN
        UPDATE fa
        SET
            active = 0,
            updated_at = GETDATE()
        FROM dbo.FactoryArtifacts fa
        INNER JOIN @payload p ON fa.factoryArtifactId = p.factoryArtifactId;
    END

    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', 'Inserted/Updated/Deleted Successfully');
    COMMIT TRANSACTION;

Finish:
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');

END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0
        ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].error', '1');
    SET @Outputmessage = JSON_MODIFY(@Outputmessage, '$.result[0].msg', ERROR_MESSAGE());
    SELECT
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.value') AS value,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.msg')   AS msg,
        JSON_VALUE(value,'$.error') AS error
    FROM OPENJSON(@Outputmessage,'$.result');
END CATCH
